title: Google Ads for Vets | Veterinary PPC Management | GrowDVM

facts.fact: GrowDVM reports that one clinic owner, Dr. Singh of Alta Animal Hospital, cited a 20-30x return on ad spend.
facts.quote:
20-30×

return on ad spend reported by one clinic owner

facts.fact: GrowDVM says it runs weekly campaign reviews, search-term checks, and budget adjustments for clients.
facts.quote:
Weekly

campaign reviews, search-term checks, and budget adjustments

facts.fact: GrowDVM's Google Ads service is offered to independent veterinary clinics across the US and Canada.
facts.quote:
US + CA

independent veterinary clinics across the US and Canada

facts.fact: GrowDVM's Google Ads contracts have a 3-month initial term, then month-to-month, with cancellation on 30 days notice and no exit fees.
facts.quote: **3-month initial term, then month-to-month.** The 3 months give us time to launch the campaigns

facts.fact: After the initial term, GrowDVM clients can leave any month with 30 days notice.
facts.quote: After that, you can leave any month with 30 days notice. No surprise renewals, no exit fees.

facts.fact: GrowDVM states that Google Ads spend is paid directly to Google, and campaign management is a separate cost.
facts.quote: Ad spend goes directly to Google; campaign management is a separate cost.

facts.fact: GrowDVM states that the Google Ads account is in the client's name and the client pays Google directly for ads.
facts.quote: The account is in your name. You pay Google directly for ads. We manage it for you.

facts.fact: GrowDVM offers a free 30-minute audit of a clinic's Google Ads targeting, wasted spend, and conversion tracking.
facts.quote: Book a free 30-minute audit. We review your targeting, wasted spend, and conversion tracking

facts.fact: GrowDVM's Google Ads reporting includes ad spend, inquiries, and cost per qualified inquiry, and it reconciles inquiries with front-desk appointment records.
facts.quote: Your report shows ad spend, inquiries, and cost per qualified inquiry.

facts.fact: GrowDVM states that for Search campaigns, the advertiser pays when someone clicks the ad (pay-per-click model).
facts.quote: Search campaigns use a pay-per-click model: you pay when someone clicks your ad.

facts.fact: Dr. Singh of Alta Animal Hospital (Clovis, CA) is quoted as saying he received twenty to thirty dollars back for every dollar spent on ads.
facts.quote: For every dollar I spent on ads, I was getting twenty to thirty back.
